about_the_game:
🏗️ Build a Unique Wildling-Friendly City

  • Construct specialized homes, training centers, and elemental relaxation spas for your Wildlings.

  • Design your city’s layout with cultural, nature, and entertainment decorations to maximize your Wildlings’ happiness.

  • Expand your town by claiming new territories, unlocking rare Wildlings and unique resources.

🛠️ Train & Evolve Your Wildling Helpers

  • Wildlings gain experience slowly through work but train efficiently in specialized facilities.

  • Unlock evolutionary paths by meeting happiness, experience, and resource requirements.

  • Discover unique abilities that impact your city and competitions, from energy-efficient Wildlings to rare, high-value species.

🏆 Compete in Thrilling Leagues & Stadiums

  • Build and upgrade stadiums to host various sports-like Wildling competitions.

  • Train your Wildlings for different battle formats, from casual 1v1 duels to high-stakes 5v5 league matches.

  • Manage your city's reputation through victories, attracting stronger tamers and elite Wildlings.

🤝 Catch, Recruit & Bond with Tamers

  • Attract Wildlings to your city by fulfilling their needs and offering valuable resources.

  • Assign tamers to Wildlings, forming bonds that enhance their battle and work performance.

  • Maintain your city's reputation to bring in skilled tamers with powerful perks.

🌍 A Dynamic & Evolving World

  • Each territory features different environmental influences, affecting which Wildlings can thrive.

  • Special Cthulhu-inspired events introduce unexpected challenges and rewards.

  • No traditional tech tree—unlock new buildings based on the Wildlings you’ve recruited!

🎶 Expressive Sounds & Lively Atmosphere

  • Enjoy a fully immersive experience where both tamers and Wildlings communicate in their own unique gibberish language.

  • Watch your city come to life with bustling activity as Wildlings and tamers roam freely.

Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate Tamer Town? Start your adventure today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 z 3,2 GHz lub AMD Ryzen 3 1200 z 3,1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 with 2 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 270X with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K z 3,5 GHz lub AMD Ryzen 5 1500X z 3,5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 with 4 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 290X with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

short_description: Build, Train, and Compete in a City of Tamers and Wildlings! Develop a thriving town for tamers and their powerful Wildlings! Manage resources, design a harmonious environment, and prepare your Wildlings for thrilling competitions in various battle leagues. Create the ultimate Wildling metropolis.
